problem: Reduce inventory carrying costs across 200 stores. Team: 6 planners. Tools: Excel and SAP. Maturity 2. The client is small.

personas.name: Amina Shah
personas.title: Store operations lead
personas.insight: The extra stock sits in the back room, not on the shelf.
personas.recommendation: Count back-room units before changing the reorder point.

personas.name: Luis Ortega
personas.title: Inventory planner
personas.insight: One reorder point for 200 stores overbuys the slow stores.
personas.recommendation: Set the reorder point by store, not by chain.

personas.name: Priya Raman
personas.title: Finance partner
personas.insight: Carrying cost is the holding rate times the units above the target.
personas.recommendation: Report carrying cost by store each week.

personas.name: Owen Blake
personas.title: Supply planner
personas.insight: A lower target fails if the supplier lead time is wrong.
personas.recommendation: Check lead time before cutting the target.

panel.consensus: Count the stock, then set a reorder point by store.
panel.dissent: Owen Blake wants the lead time checked before the target moves.

current.task: Planners count units in each store.
A planner writes the reorder point.

future.task: An agent counts on-hand units by store.
An agent drafts the reorder point from the count.
An agent lists stores over the holding target.

chart.summary: Agents count the stock and a planner approves the buy.
